Option 1 - Set the Attack Surface Reduction rule GUID be9ba2d9-53ea-4cdc-84e5-9b1eeee46550 to Block.
Option 2 - Run Add-MpPreference -AttackSurfaceReductionRules_Ids be9ba2d9-53ea-4cdc-84e5-9b1eeee46550 -AttackSurfaceReductionRules_Actions Enabled.

ConfigurationName: Block Office communication application from creating child processes
ConfigurationDescription: Prevents Outlook from launching child processes, which stops payloads that rely on the mail client spawning a shell or script host.
ConfigurationRationale: Blocking child process creation removes an entire class of social engineering and exploit chains that pivot through the mail client.
RemediationOptions: Option 1 - Set the Attack Surface Reduction rule GUID 26190899-1602-49e8-8b27-eb1d0a1ce869 to Block.

ConfigurationName: Enable Local Security Authority protection
ConfigurationDescription: Runs the Local Security Authority as a protected process so that unsigned code cannot read or inject into it.
ConfigurationRationale: Protected process light prevents credential dumping tools from attaching to LSASS even when the operator holds administrator rights.
RemediationOptions: Set registry value HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa\RunAsPPL to 1 and restart the device.

ConfigurationName: Disable the SMBv1 client and server
ConfigurationDescription: Removes the deprecated Server Message Block version 1 protocol, which has no support for signing or encryption.
ConfigurationRationale: SMBv1 has been superseded for more than a decade and is the transport abused by several self-propagating families.
RemediationOptions: Run Disable-WindowsOptionalFeature -Online -FeatureName SMB1Protocol on Windows client, or Remove-WindowsFeature FS-SMB1 on Windows Server.

ConfigurationName: Disable anonymous enumeration of shares
ConfigurationDescription: Determines whether anonymous logon users, that is null session connections, are allowed to list all account names and enumerate all shared resources.
ConfigurationRationale: Denying anonymous enumeration removes an unauthenticated discovery path into the estate.
RemediationOptions:
Option 1 - Set the following Group Policy:
Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Local Policies\Security Options\Network access: Do not allow anonymous enumeration of SAM accounts and shares to Enabled.

ConfigurationName: Disable the built-in guest account
ConfigurationDescription: Ensures the local guest account is disabled so it cannot be used to access the device without credentials.
ConfigurationRationale: The guest account provides unauthenticated access and is not required in a managed environment.
RemediationOptions: Set Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Local Policies\Security Options\Accounts: Guest account status to Disabled.

ConfigurationName: Enable PowerShell script block logging
ConfigurationDescription: Records the content of every script block PowerShell executes, including code that was decoded or generated at runtime.
ConfigurationRationale: Script block logging is frequently the only durable record of an obfuscated or in-memory payload.
RemediationOptions: Set Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\Windows PowerShell\Turn on PowerShell Script Block Logging to Enabled.

ConfigurationName: Enable the Windows Defender Firewall for the domain profile
ConfigurationDescription: Ensures host firewall filtering remains active while the device is connected to the corporate network.
ConfigurationRationale: Host firewalling contains lateral movement even when the network perimeter has been crossed.
RemediationOptions: Set Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Windows Defender Firewall\Domain Profile\Firewall state to On.

ConfigurationName: Enable Microsoft Defender Antivirus real-time protection
ConfigurationDescription: Keeps always-on scanning enabled so that malicious files are inspected as they are written and executed.
ConfigurationRationale: Real-time protection is the control that stops commodity payloads before execution.
RemediationOptions: Run Set-MpPreference -DisableRealtimeMonitoring $false, and ensure tamper protection is enabled so the setting cannot be reverted.

ConfigurationName: Turn on potentially unwanted application protection in block mode
ConfigurationDescription: Blocks software that is not outright malicious but that degrades the security posture of the device, such as bundled toolbars and unauthorised remote access utilities.
ConfigurationRationale: Unwanted applications frequently provide the remote access channel an intruder later reuses.
RemediationOptions: Run Set-MpPreference -PUAProtection Enabled.

ConfigurationDescription: Encrypts the system volume so that data cannot be read by removing the disk or booting an alternative operating system.
ConfigurationRationale: Full volume encryption is the control that makes device loss a property incident rather than a data breach.
RemediationOptions: Enable BitLocker with a TPM protector and escrow the recovery key to Microsoft Entra ID before enforcing the policy.

ConfigurationDescription: Determines whether an existing internet connection, such as through wireless, can be shared and used by other systems, essentially creating a mobile hotspot.

Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Network\Network Connections\Prohibit use of Internet Connection Sharing on your DNS domain network to Enabled.

ConfigurationRationale: An unonboarded device is a blind spot; no detection or response capability applies to it.
RemediationOptions: Deploy the onboarding package from the Microsoft Defender portal, or assign the onboarding profile through Microsoft Intune.

ConfigurationName: Block credential stealing from the Windows local security authority subsystem
ConfigurationDescription: Attack Surface Reduction rules block the techniques most commonly used in malware and hands-on-keyboard intrusions. This rule prevents processes from opening a handle to lsass.exe to read credential material from memory.
ConfigurationRationale: Credential material harvested from LSASS enables lateral movement using valid accounts, which is difficult to detect once the attacker holds a legitimate ticket or hash.
RemediationOptions:
Option 1 - Set the following Group Policy:
Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\Microsoft Defender Antivirus\Microsoft Defender Exploit Guard\Attack Surface Reduction to Enabled and add rule GUID 9e6c4e1f-7d60-472f-ba1a-a39ef669e4b2 with value 1.
Option 2 - Run Set-MpPreference -AttackSurfaceReductionRules_Ids 9e6c4e1f-7d60-472f-ba1a-a39ef669e4b2 -AttackSurfaceReductionRules_Actions Enabled.

ConfigurationName: Block executable content from email client and webmail
ConfigurationDescription: Prevents executable files and scripts delivered as mail attachments from launching on the endpoint.
ConfigurationRationale: Mail remains the most common initial access vector, and blocking execution at the client stops the payload before it establishes a foothold.
RemediationOptions:
Option 1 - Set the Attack Surface Reduction rule GUID be9ba2d9-53ea-4cdc-84e5-9b1eeee46550 to Block.
Option 2 - Run Add-MpPreference -AttackSurfaceReductionRules_Ids be9ba2d9-53ea-4cdc-84e5-9b1eeee46550 -AttackSurfaceReductionRules_Actions Enabled.

ConfigurationName: Block Office communication application from creating child processes
ConfigurationDescription: Prevents Outlook from launching child processes, which stops payloads that rely on the mail client spawning a shell or script host.
ConfigurationRationale: Blocking child process creation removes an entire class of social engineering and exploit chains that pivot through the mail client.
RemediationOptions: Option 1 - Set the Attack Surface Reduction rule GUID 26190899-1602-49e8-8b27-eb1d0a1ce869 to Block.

ConfigurationName: Enable Local Security Authority protection
ConfigurationDescription: Runs the Local Security Authority as a protected process so that unsigned code cannot read or inject into it.
ConfigurationRationale: Protected process light prevents credential dumping tools from attaching to LSASS even when the operator holds administrator rights.
RemediationOptions: Set registry value HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa\RunAsPPL to 1 and restart the device.

ConfigurationName: Disable the SMBv1 client and server
ConfigurationDescription: Removes the deprecated Server Message Block version 1 protocol, which has no support for signing or encryption.
ConfigurationRationale: SMBv1 has been superseded for more than a decade and is the transport abused by several self-propagating families.
RemediationOptions: Run Disable-WindowsOptionalFeature -Online -FeatureName SMB1Protocol on Windows client, or Remove-WindowsFeature FS-SMB1 on Windows Server.

ConfigurationName: Disable anonymous enumeration of shares
ConfigurationDescription: Determines whether anonymous logon users, that is null session connections, are allowed to list all account names and enumerate all shared resources.
ConfigurationRationale: Denying anonymous enumeration removes an unauthenticated discovery path into the estate.
RemediationOptions:
Option 1 - Set the following Group Policy:
Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Local Policies\Security Options\Network access: Do not allow anonymous enumeration of SAM accounts and shares to Enabled.

ConfigurationName: Disable the built-in guest account
ConfigurationDescription: Ensures the local guest account is disabled so it cannot be used to access the device without credentials.
ConfigurationRationale: The guest account provides unauthenticated access and is not required in a managed environment.
RemediationOptions: Set Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Local Policies\Security Options\Accounts: Guest account status to Disabled.

ConfigurationName: Enable PowerShell script block logging
ConfigurationDescription: Records the content of every script block PowerShell executes, including code that was decoded or generated at runtime.
ConfigurationRationale: Script block logging is frequently the only durable record of an obfuscated or in-memory payload.
RemediationOptions: Set Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\Windows PowerShell\Turn on PowerShell Script Block Logging to Enabled.

ConfigurationName: Enable the Windows Defender Firewall for the domain profile
ConfigurationDescription: Ensures host firewall filtering remains active while the device is connected to the corporate network.
ConfigurationRationale: Host firewalling contains lateral movement even when the network perimeter has been crossed.
RemediationOptions: Set Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Windows Defender Firewall\Domain Profile\Firewall state to On.

ConfigurationName: Enable Microsoft Defender Antivirus real-time protection
ConfigurationDescription: Keeps always-on scanning enabled so that malicious files are inspected as they are written and executed.
ConfigurationRationale: Real-time protection is the control that stops commodity payloads before execution.
RemediationOptions: Run Set-MpPreference -DisableRealtimeMonitoring $false, and ensure tamper protection is enabled so the setting cannot be reverted.

ConfigurationName: Turn on potentially unwanted application protection in block mode
ConfigurationDescription: Blocks software that is not outright malicious but that degrades the security posture of the device, such as bundled toolbars and unauthorised remote access utilities.
ConfigurationRationale: Unwanted applications frequently provide the remote access channel an intruder later reuses.
RemediationOptions: Run Set-MpPreference -PUAProtection Enabled.

ConfigurationName: Enable BitLocker on the operating system drive
ConfigurationDescription: Encrypts the system volume so that data cannot be read by removing the disk or booting an alternative operating system.
ConfigurationRationale: Full volume encryption is the control that makes device loss a property incident rather than a data breach.
RemediationOptions: Enable BitLocker with a TPM protector and escrow the recovery key to Microsoft Entra ID before enforcing the policy.

ConfigurationName: Prohibit use of Internet Connection Sharing on your DNS domain network
ConfigurationDescription: Determines whether an existing internet connection, such as through wireless, can be shared and used by other systems, essentially creating a mobile hotspot.
ConfigurationRationale: Connection sharing creates an unmanaged bridge between the corporate network and an untrusted one.
RemediationOptions:
Option 1 - Set the following Group Policy:
Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Network\Network Connections\Prohibit use of Internet Connection Sharing on your DNS domain network to Enabled.

RemediationOptions: Run Set-MpPreference -PUAProtection Enabled.

RemediationOptions: Enable BitLocker with a TPM protector and escrow the recovery key to Microsoft Entra ID before enforcing the policy.

ConfigurationName: Prohibit use of Internet Connection Sharing on your DNS domain network
ConfigurationDescription: Determines whether an existing internet connection, such as through wireless, can be shared and used by other systems, essentially creating a mobile hotspot.
ConfigurationRationale: Connection sharing creates an unmanaged bridge between the corporate network and an untrusted one.
RemediationOptions:
Option 1 - Set the following Group Policy:
Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Network\Network Connections\Prohibit use of Internet Connection Sharing on your DNS domain network to Enabled.

ConfigurationName: Onboard devices to Microsoft Defender for Endpoint
ConfigurationDescription: Ensures the endpoint reports sensor telemetry so detection, investigation, and response are possible on that device.
ConfigurationRationale: An unonboarded device is a blind spot; no detection or response capability applies to it.
RemediationOptions: Deploy the onboarding package from the Microsoft Defender portal, or assign the onboarding profile through Microsoft Intune.

ConfigurationName: Block credential stealing from the Windows local security authority subsystem
ConfigurationDescription: Attack Surface Reduction rules block the techniques most commonly used in malware and hands-on-keyboard intrusions. This rule prevents processes from opening a handle to lsass.exe to read credential material from memory.
ConfigurationRationale: Credential material harvested from LSASS enables lateral movement using valid accounts, which is difficult to detect once the attacker holds a legitimate ticket or hash.
RemediationOptions:
Option 1 - Set the following Group Policy:
Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\Microsoft Defender Antivirus\Microsoft Defender Exploit Guard\Attack Surface Reduction to Enabled and add rule GUID 9e6c4e1f-7d60-472f-ba1a-a39ef669e4b2 with value 1.
Option 2 - Run Set-MpPreference -AttackSurfaceReductionRules_Ids 9e6c4e1f-7d60-472f-ba1a-a39ef669e4b2 -AttackSurfaceReductionRules_Actions Enabled.

ConfigurationName: Block executable content from email client and webmail
ConfigurationDescription: Prevents executable files and scripts delivered as mail attachments from launching on the endpoint.
ConfigurationRationale: Mail remains the most common initial access vector, and blocking execution at the client stops the payload before it establishes a foothold.
RemediationOptions:
Option 1 - Set the Attack Surface Reduction rule GUID be9ba2d9-53ea-4cdc-84e5-9b1eeee46550 to Block.
Option 2 - Run Add-MpPreference -AttackSurfaceReductionRules_Ids be9ba2d9-53ea-4cdc-84e5-9b1eeee46550 -AttackSurfaceReductionRules_Actions Enabled.

ConfigurationName: Block Office communication application from creating child processes
ConfigurationDescription: Prevents Outlook from launching child processes, which stops payloads that rely on the mail client spawning a shell or script host.

Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Local Policies\Security Options\Network access: Do not allow anonymous enumeration of SAM accounts and shares to Enabled.

ConfigurationDescription: Ensures the local guest account is disabled so it cannot be used to access the device without credentials.
ConfigurationRationale: The guest account provides unauthenticated access and is not required in a managed environment.
RemediationOptions: Set Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Local Policies\Security Options\Accounts: Guest account status to Disabled.

ConfigurationName: Enable PowerShell script block logging
ConfigurationDescription: Records the content of every script block PowerShell executes, including code that was decoded or generated at runtime.
ConfigurationRationale: Script block logging is frequently the only durable record of an obfuscated or in-memory payload.
RemediationOptions: Set Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\Windows PowerShell\Turn on PowerShell Script Block Logging to Enabled.

ConfigurationName: Enable the Windows Defender Firewall for the domain profile
ConfigurationDescription: Ensures host firewall filtering remains active while the device is connected to the corporate network.
ConfigurationRationale: Host firewalling contains lateral movement even when the network perimeter has been crossed.
RemediationOptions: Set Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Windows Defender Firewall\Domain Profile\Firewall state to On.

ConfigurationName: Enable Microsoft Defender Antivirus real-time protection
ConfigurationDescription: Keeps always-on scanning enabled so that malicious files are inspected as they are written and executed.
ConfigurationRationale: Real-time protection is the control that stops commodity payloads before execution.
RemediationOptions: Run Set-MpPreference -DisableRealtimeMonitoring $false, and ensure tamper protection is enabled so the setting cannot be reverted.

ConfigurationName: Turn on potentially unwanted application protection in block mode
ConfigurationDescription: Blocks software that is not outright malicious but that degrades the security posture of the device, such as bundled toolbars and unauthorised remote access utilities.
ConfigurationRationale: Unwanted applications frequently provide the remote access channel an intruder later reuses.
RemediationOptions: Run Set-MpPreference -PUAProtection Enabled.

ConfigurationName: Enable BitLocker on the operating system drive
ConfigurationDescription: Encrypts the system volume so that data cannot be read by removing the disk or booting an alternative operating system.
ConfigurationRationale: Full volume encryption is the control that makes device loss a property incident rather than a data breach.
RemediationOptions: Enable BitLocker with a TPM protector and escrow the recovery key to Microsoft Entra ID before enforcing the policy.

ConfigurationName: Prohibit use of Internet Connection Sharing on your DNS domain network
ConfigurationDescription: Determines whether an existing internet connection, such as through wireless, can be shared and used by other systems, essentially creating a mobile hotspot.
ConfigurationRationale: Connection sharing creates an unmanaged bridge between the corporate network and an untrusted one.
RemediationOptions:
Option 1 - Set the following Group Policy:
Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Network\Network Connections\Prohibit use of Internet Connection Sharing on your DNS domain network to Enabled.

ConfigurationName: Onboard devices to Microsoft Defender for Endpoint
ConfigurationDescription: Ensures the endpoint reports sensor telemetry so detection, investigation, and response are possible on that device.
ConfigurationRationale: An unonboarded device is a blind spot; no detection or response capability applies to it.
RemediationOptions: Deploy the onboarding package from the Microsoft Defender portal, or assign the onboarding profile through Microsoft Intune.

ConfigurationName: Block credential stealing from the Windows local security authority subsystem
ConfigurationDescription: Attack Surface Reduction rules block the techniques most commonly used in malware and hands-on-keyboard intrusions. This rule prevents processes from opening a handle to lsass.exe to read credential material from memory.
ConfigurationRationale: Credential material harvested from LSASS enables lateral movement using valid accounts, which is difficult to detect once the attacker holds a legitimate ticket or hash.
RemediationOptions:
Option 1 - Set the following Group Policy:
Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\Microsoft Defender Antivirus\Microsoft Defender Exploit Guard\Attack Surface Reduction to Enabled and add rule GUID 9e6c4e1f-7d60-472f-ba1a-a39ef669e4b2 with value 1.
Option 2 - Run Set-MpPreference -AttackSurfaceReductionRules_Ids 9e6c4e1f-7d60-472f-ba1a-a39ef669e4b2 -AttackSurfaceReductionRules_Actions Enabled.

ConfigurationName: Block executable content from email client and webmail
ConfigurationDescription: Prevents executable files and scripts delivered as mail attachments from launching on the endpoint.
ConfigurationRationale: Mail remains the most common initial access vector, and blocking execution at the client stops the payload before it establishes a foothold.
RemediationOptions:
Option 1 - Set the Attack Surface Reduction rule GUID be9ba2d9-53ea-4cdc-84e5-9b1eeee46550 to Block.
Option 2 - Run Add-MpPreference -AttackSurfaceReductionRules_Ids be9ba2d9-53ea-4cdc-84e5-9b1eeee46550 -AttackSurfaceReductionRules_Actions Enabled.

ConfigurationName: Block Office communication application from creating child processes
ConfigurationDescription: Prevents Outlook from launching child processes, which stops payloads that rely on the mail client spawning a shell or script host.
ConfigurationRationale: Blocking child process creation removes an entire class of social engineering and exploit chains that pivot through the mail client.
RemediationOptions: Option 1 - Set the Attack Surface Reduction rule GUID 26190899-1602-49e8-8b27-eb1d0a1ce869 to Block.

ConfigurationName: Enable Local Security Authority protection
ConfigurationDescription: Runs the Local Security Authority as a protected process so that unsigned code cannot read or inject into it.
ConfigurationRationale: Protected process light prevents credential dumping tools from attaching to LSASS even when the operator holds administrator rights.
RemediationOptions: Set registry value HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa\RunAsPPL to 1 and restart the device.

ConfigurationName: Disable the SMBv1 client and server
ConfigurationDescription: Removes the deprecated Server Message Block version 1 protocol, which has no support for signing or encryption.
ConfigurationRationale: SMBv1 has been superseded for more than a decade and is the transport abused by several self-propagating families.
RemediationOptions: Run Disable-WindowsOptionalFeature -Online -FeatureName SMB1Protocol on Windows client, or Remove-WindowsFeature FS-SMB1 on Windows Server.

RemediationOptions: Option 1 - Set the Attack Surface Reduction rule GUID 26190899-1602-49e8-8b27-eb1d0a1ce869 to Block.

ConfigurationName: Enable Local Security Authority protection
ConfigurationDescription: Runs the Local Security Authority as a protected process so that unsigned code cannot read or inject into it.
ConfigurationRationale: Protected process light prevents credential dumping tools from attaching to LSASS even when the operator holds administrator rights.
RemediationOptions: Set registry value HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa\RunAsPPL to 1 and restart the device.

ConfigurationName: Disable the SMBv1 client and server
ConfigurationDescription: Removes the deprecated Server Message Block version 1 protocol, which has no support for signing or encryption.
ConfigurationRationale: SMBv1 has been superseded for more than a decade and is the transport abused by several self-propagating families.
RemediationOptions: Run Disable-WindowsOptionalFeature -Online -FeatureName SMB1Protocol on Windows client, or Remove-WindowsFeature FS-SMB1 on Windows Server.

ConfigurationName: Disable anonymous enumeration of shares
ConfigurationDescription: Determines whether anonymous logon users, that is null session connections, are allowed to list all account names and enumerate all shared resources.
ConfigurationRationale: Denying anonymous enumeration removes an unauthenticated discovery path into the estate.
RemediationOptions:
Option 1 - Set the following Group Policy:
Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Local Policies\Security Options\Network access: Do not allow anonymous enumeration of SAM accounts and shares to Enabled.

ConfigurationName: Disable the built-in guest account
ConfigurationDescription: Ensures the local guest account is disabled so it cannot be used to access the device without credentials.
ConfigurationRationale: The guest account provides unauthenticated access and is not required in a managed environment.
RemediationOptions: Set Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Local Policies\Security Options\Accounts: Guest account status to Disabled.

ConfigurationName: Enable PowerShell script block logging
ConfigurationDescription: Records the content of every script block PowerShell executes, including code that was decoded or generated at runtime.
ConfigurationRationale: Script block logging is frequently the only durable record of an obfuscated or in-memory payload.
RemediationOptions: Set Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\Windows PowerShell\Turn on PowerShell Script Block Logging to Enabled.

ConfigurationName: Enable the Windows Defender Firewall for the domain profile
ConfigurationDescription: Ensures host firewall filtering remains active while the device is connected to the corporate network.
ConfigurationRationale: Host firewalling contains lateral movement even when the network perimeter has been crossed.
RemediationOptions: Set Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Windows Defender Firewall\Domain Profile\Firewall state to On.

ConfigurationName: Enable Microsoft Defender Antivirus real-time protection
ConfigurationDescription: Keeps always-on scanning enabled so that malicious files are inspected as they are written and executed.
ConfigurationRationale: Real-time protection is the control that stops commodity payloads before execution.
RemediationOptions: Run Set-MpPreference -DisableRealtimeMonitoring $false, and ensure tamper protection is enabled so the setting cannot be reverted.

ConfigurationName: Turn on potentially unwanted application protection in block mode
ConfigurationDescription: Blocks software that is not outright malicious but that degrades the security posture of the device, such as bundled toolbars and unauthorised remote access utilities.
ConfigurationRationale: Unwanted applications frequently provide the remote access channel an intruder later reuses.
RemediationOptions: Run Set-MpPreference -PUAProtection Enabled.

ConfigurationName: Enable BitLocker on the operating system drive
ConfigurationDescription: Encrypts the system volume so that data cannot be read by removing the disk or booting an alternative operating system.
ConfigurationRationale: Full volume encryption is the control that makes device loss a property incident rather than a data breach.
RemediationOptions: Enable BitLocker with a TPM protector and escrow the recovery key to Microsoft Entra ID before enforcing the policy.

ConfigurationName: Prohibit use of Internet Connection Sharing on your DNS domain network
ConfigurationDescription: Determines whether an existing internet connection, such as through wireless, can be shared and used by other systems, essentially creating a mobile hotspot.
ConfigurationRationale: Connection sharing creates an unmanaged bridge between the corporate network and an untrusted one.
RemediationOptions:
Option 1 - Set the following Group Policy:
Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Network\Network Connections\Prohibit use of Internet Connection Sharing on your DNS domain network to Enabled.

ConfigurationName: Onboard devices to Microsoft Defender for Endpoint
ConfigurationDescription: Ensures the endpoint reports sensor telemetry so detection, investigation, and response are possible on that device.
ConfigurationRationale: An unonboarded device is a blind spot; no detection or response capability applies to it.
RemediationOptions: Deploy the onboarding package from the Microsoft Defender portal, or assign the onboarding profile through Microsoft Intune.

ConfigurationName: Block credential stealing from the Windows local security authority subsystem
ConfigurationDescription: Attack Surface Reduction rules block the techniques most commonly used in malware and hands-on-keyboard intrusions. This rule prevents processes from opening a handle to lsass.exe to read credential material from memory.
ConfigurationRationale: Credential material harvested from LSASS enables lateral movement using valid accounts, which is difficult to detect once the attacker holds a legitimate ticket or hash.
RemediationOptions:
Option 1 - Set the following Group Policy:
Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\Microsoft Defender Antivirus\Microsoft Defender Exploit Guard\Attack Surface Reduction to Enabled and add rule GUID 9e6c4e1f-7d60-472f-ba1a-a39ef669e4b2 with value 1.
Option 2 - Run Set-MpPreference -AttackSurfaceReductionRules_Ids 9e6c4e1f-7d60-472f-ba1a-a39ef669e4b2 -AttackSurfaceReductionRules_Actions Enabled.

ConfigurationName: Block executable content from email client and webmail
ConfigurationDescription: Prevents executable files and scripts delivered as mail attachments from launching on the endpoint.
ConfigurationRationale: Mail remains the most common initial access vector, and blocking execution at the client stops the payload before it establishes a foothold.
RemediationOptions:
Option 1 - Set the Attack Surface Reduction rule GUID be9ba2d9-53ea-4cdc-84e5-9b1eeee46550 to Block.

Option 1 - Set the following Group Policy:
Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\Microsoft Defender Antivirus\Microsoft Defender Exploit Guard\Attack Surface Reduction to Enabled and add rule GUID 9e6c4e1f-7d60-472f-ba1a-a39ef669e4b2 with value 1.
Option 2 - Run Set-MpPreference -AttackSurfaceReductionRules_Ids 9e6c4e1f-7d60-472f-ba1a-a39ef669e4b2 -AttackSurfaceReductionRules_Actions Enabled.

ConfigurationName: Block executable content from email client and webmail
ConfigurationDescription: Prevents executable files and scripts delivered as mail attachments from launching on the endpoint.
ConfigurationRationale: Mail remains the most common initial access vector, and blocking execution at the client stops the payload before it establishes a foothold.
RemediationOptions:
Option 1 - Set the Attack Surface Reduction rule GUID be9ba2d9-53ea-4cdc-84e5-9b1eeee46550 to Block.
Option 2 - Run Add-MpPreference -AttackSurfaceReductionRules_Ids be9ba2d9-53ea-4cdc-84e5-9b1eeee46550 -AttackSurfaceReductionRules_Actions Enabled.

ConfigurationName: Block Office communication application from creating child processes
ConfigurationDescription: Prevents Outlook from launching child processes, which stops payloads that rely on the mail client spawning a shell or script host.
ConfigurationRationale: Blocking child process creation removes an entire class of social engineering and exploit chains that pivot through the mail client.
RemediationOptions: Option 1 - Set the Attack Surface Reduction rule GUID 26190899-1602-49e8-8b27-eb1d0a1ce869 to Block.

ConfigurationName: Enable Local Security Authority protection
ConfigurationDescription: Runs the Local Security Authority as a protected process so that unsigned code cannot read or inject into it.
ConfigurationRationale: Protected process light prevents credential dumping tools from attaching to LSASS even when the operator holds administrator rights.
RemediationOptions: Set registry value HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa\RunAsPPL to 1 and restart the device.

ConfigurationName: Disable the SMBv1 client and server
ConfigurationDescription: Removes the deprecated Server Message Block version 1 protocol, which has no support for signing or encryption.
ConfigurationRationale: SMBv1 has been superseded for more than a decade and is the transport abused by several self-propagating families.
RemediationOptions: Run Disable-WindowsOptionalFeature -Online -FeatureName SMB1Protocol on Windows client, or Remove-WindowsFeature FS-SMB1 on Windows Server.

ConfigurationName: Disable anonymous enumeration of shares
ConfigurationDescription: Determines whether anonymous logon users, that is null session connections, are allowed to list all account names and enumerate all shared resources.
ConfigurationRationale: Denying anonymous enumeration removes an unauthenticated discovery path into the estate.
RemediationOptions:
Option 1 - Set the following Group Policy:
Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Local Policies\Security Options\Network access: Do not allow anonymous enumeration of SAM accounts and shares to Enabled.

ConfigurationName: Disable the built-in guest account
ConfigurationDescription: Ensures the local guest account is disabled so it cannot be used to access the device without credentials.
ConfigurationRationale: The guest account provides unauthenticated access and is not required in a managed environment.
RemediationOptions: Set Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Local Policies\Security Options\Accounts: Guest account status to Disabled.

ConfigurationName: Enable PowerShell script block logging
ConfigurationDescription: Records the content of every script block PowerShell executes, including code that was decoded or generated at runtime.
ConfigurationRationale: Script block logging is frequently the only durable record of an obfuscated or in-memory payload.
RemediationOptions: Set Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\Windows PowerShell\Turn on PowerShell Script Block Logging to Enabled.

ConfigurationName: Enable the Windows Defender Firewall for the domain profile
ConfigurationDescription: Ensures host firewall filtering remains active while the device is connected to the corporate network.
ConfigurationRationale: Host firewalling contains lateral movement even when the network perimeter has been crossed.
RemediationOptions: Set Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Windows Defender Firewall\Domain Profile\Firewall state to On.

ConfigurationName: Enable Microsoft Defender Antivirus real-time protection
ConfigurationDescription: Keeps always-on scanning enabled so that malicious files are inspected as they are written and executed.
ConfigurationRationale: Real-time protection is the control that stops commodity payloads before execution.
RemediationOptions: Run Set-MpPreference -DisableRealtimeMonitoring $false, and ensure tamper protection is enabled so the setting cannot be reverted.

ConfigurationName: Turn on potentially unwanted application protection in block mode
ConfigurationDescription: Blocks software that is not outright malicious but that degrades the security posture of the device, such as bundled toolbars and unauthorised remote access utilities.
ConfigurationRationale: Unwanted applications frequently provide the remote access channel an intruder later reuses.
RemediationOptions: Run Set-MpPreference -PUAProtection Enabled.

ConfigurationName: Enable BitLocker on the operating system drive
ConfigurationDescription: Encrypts the system volume so that data cannot be read by removing the disk or booting an alternative operating system.
ConfigurationRationale: Full volume encryption is the control that makes device loss a property incident rather than a data breach.
RemediationOptions: Enable BitLocker with a TPM protector and escrow the recovery key to Microsoft Entra ID before enforcing the policy.

ConfigurationName: Prohibit use of Internet Connection Sharing on your DNS domain network

Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Network\Network Connections\Prohibit use of Internet Connection Sharing on your DNS domain network to Enabled.

RemediationOptions: Enable BitLocker with a TPM protector and escrow the recovery key to Microsoft Entra ID before enforcing the policy.

ConfigurationName: Prohibit use of Internet Connection Sharing on your DNS domain network
ConfigurationDescription: Determines whether an existing internet connection, such as through wireless, can be shared and used by other systems, essentially creating a mobile hotspot.
ConfigurationRationale: Connection sharing creates an unmanaged bridge between the corporate network and an untrusted one.
RemediationOptions:
Option 1 - Set the following Group Policy:
Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Network\Network Connections\Prohibit use of Internet Connection Sharing on your DNS domain network to Enabled.

ConfigurationName: Onboard devices to Microsoft Defender for Endpoint
ConfigurationDescription: Ensures the endpoint reports sensor telemetry so detection, investigation, and response are possible on that device.
ConfigurationRationale: An unonboarded device is a blind spot; no detection or response capability applies to it.
RemediationOptions: Deploy the onboarding package from the Microsoft Defender portal, or assign the onboarding profile through Microsoft Intune.

ConfigurationName: Block credential stealing from the Windows local security authority subsystem
ConfigurationDescription: Attack Surface Reduction rules block the techniques most commonly used in malware and hands-on-keyboard intrusions. This rule prevents processes from opening a handle to lsass.exe to read credential material from memory.
ConfigurationRationale: Credential material harvested from LSASS enables lateral movement using valid accounts, which is difficult to detect once the attacker holds a legitimate ticket or hash.
RemediationOptions:
Option 1 - Set the following Group Policy:
Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\Microsoft Defender Antivirus\Microsoft Defender Exploit Guard\Attack Surface Reduction to Enabled and add rule GUID 9e6c4e1f-7d60-472f-ba1a-a39ef669e4b2 with value 1.
Option 2 - Run Set-MpPreference -AttackSurfaceReductionRules_Ids 9e6c4e1f-7d60-472f-ba1a-a39ef669e4b2 -AttackSurfaceReductionRules_Actions Enabled.

ConfigurationName: Block executable content from email client and webmail
ConfigurationDescription: Prevents executable files and scripts delivered as mail attachments from launching on the endpoint.
ConfigurationRationale: Mail remains the most common initial access vector, and blocking execution at the client stops the payload before it establishes a foothold.
RemediationOptions:
Option 1 - Set the Attack Surface Reduction rule GUID be9ba2d9-53ea-4cdc-84e5-9b1eeee46550 to Block.
Option 2 - Run Add-MpPreference -AttackSurfaceReductionRules_Ids be9ba2d9-53ea-4cdc-84e5-9b1eeee46550 -AttackSurfaceReductionRules_Actions Enabled.

ConfigurationName: Block Office communication application from creating child processes
ConfigurationDescription: Prevents Outlook from launching child processes, which stops payloads that rely on the mail client spawning a shell or script host.
ConfigurationRationale: Blocking child process creation removes an entire class of social engineering and exploit chains that pivot through the mail client.
RemediationOptions: Option 1 - Set the Attack Surface Reduction rule GUID 26190899-1602-49e8-8b27-eb1d0a1ce869 to Block.

ConfigurationName: Enable Local Security Authority protection
ConfigurationDescription: Runs the Local Security Authority as a protected process so that unsigned code cannot read or inject into it.
ConfigurationRationale: Protected process light prevents credential dumping tools from attaching to LSASS even when the operator holds administrator rights.
RemediationOptions: Set registry value HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa\RunAsPPL to 1 and restart the device.

ConfigurationName: Disable the SMBv1 client and server
ConfigurationDescription: Removes the deprecated Server Message Block version 1 protocol, which has no support for signing or encryption.
ConfigurationRationale: SMBv1 has been superseded for more than a decade and is the transport abused by several self-propagating families.
RemediationOptions: Run Disable-WindowsOptionalFeature -Online -FeatureName SMB1Protocol on Windows client, or Remove-WindowsFeature FS-SMB1 on Windows Server.

ConfigurationName: Disable anonymous enumeration of shares
ConfigurationDescription: Determines whether anonymous logon users, that is null session connections, are allowed to list all account names and enumerate all shared resources.
ConfigurationRationale: Denying anonymous enumeration removes an unauthenticated discovery path into the estate.
RemediationOptions:
Option 1 - Set the following Group Policy:
Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Local Policies\Security Options\Network access: Do not allow anonymous enumeration of SAM accounts and shares to Enabled.

ConfigurationName: Disable the built-in guest account
ConfigurationDescription: Ensures the local guest account is disabled so it cannot be used to access the device without credentials.
ConfigurationRationale: The guest account provides unauthenticated access and is not required in a managed environment.
RemediationOptions: Set Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Local Policies\Security Options\Accounts: Guest account status to Disabled.

ConfigurationName: Enable PowerShell script block logging
ConfigurationDescription: Records the content of every script block PowerShell executes, including code that was decoded or generated at runtime.
ConfigurationRationale: Script block logging is frequently the only durable record of an obfuscated or in-memory payload.
RemediationOptions: Set Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\Windows PowerShell\Turn on PowerShell Script Block Logging to Enabled.

ConfigurationName: Enable the Windows Defender Firewall for the domain profile
ConfigurationDescription: Ensures host firewall filtering remains active while the device is connected to the corporate network.
ConfigurationRationale: Host firewalling contains lateral movement even when the network perimeter has been crossed.
RemediationOptions: Set Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Windows Defender Firewall\Domain Profile\Firewall state to On.

ConfigurationName: Enable Microsoft Defender Antivirus real-time protection
ConfigurationDescription: Keeps always-on scanning enabled so that malicious files are inspected as they are written and executed.
ConfigurationRationale: Real-time protection is the control that stops commodity payloads before execution.
RemediationOptions: Run Set-MpPreference -DisableRealtimeMonitoring $false, and ensure tamper protection is enabled so the setting cannot be reverted.

ConfigurationName: Turn on potentially unwanted application protection in block mode
ConfigurationDescription: Blocks software that is not outright malicious but that degrades the security posture of the device, such as bundled toolbars and unauthorised remote access utilities.
ConfigurationRationale: Unwanted applications frequently provide the remote access channel an intruder later reuses.
RemediationOptions: Run Set-MpPreference -PUAProtection Enabled.

ConfigurationDescription: Determines whether an existing internet connection, such as through wireless, can be shared and used by other systems, essentially creating a mobile hotspot.

ConfigurationName: Onboard devices to Microsoft Defender for Endpoint

Option 2 - Run Set-MpPreference -AttackSurfaceReductionRules_Ids 9e6c4e1f-7d60-472f-ba1a-a39ef669e4b2 -AttackSurfaceReductionRules_Actions Enabled.

Option 1 - Set the Attack Surface Reduction rule GUID be9ba2d9-53ea-4cdc-84e5-9b1eeee46550 to Block.

ConfigurationDescription: Prevents executable files and scripts delivered as mail attachments from launching on the endpoint.
ConfigurationRationale: Mail remains the most common initial access vector, and blocking execution at the client stops the payload before it establishes a foothold.
RemediationOptions:
Option 1 - Set the Attack Surface Reduction rule GUID be9ba2d9-53ea-4cdc-84e5-9b1eeee46550 to Block.
Option 2 - Run Add-MpPreference -AttackSurfaceReductionRules_Ids be9ba2d9-53ea-4cdc-84e5-9b1eeee46550 -AttackSurfaceReductionRules_Actions Enabled.

ConfigurationName: Block Office communication application from creating child processes
ConfigurationDescription: Prevents Outlook from launching child processes, which stops payloads that rely on the mail client spawning a shell or script host.
ConfigurationRationale: Blocking child process creation removes an entire class of social engineering and exploit chains that pivot through the mail client.
RemediationOptions: Option 1 - Set the Attack Surface Reduction rule GUID 26190899-1602-49e8-8b27-eb1d0a1ce869 to Block.

ConfigurationName: Enable Local Security Authority protection
ConfigurationDescription: Runs the Local Security Authority as a protected process so that unsigned code cannot read or inject into it.
ConfigurationRationale: Protected process light prevents credential dumping tools from attaching to LSASS even when the operator holds administrator rights.
RemediationOptions: Set registry value HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa\RunAsPPL to 1 and restart the device.

ConfigurationName: Disable the SMBv1 client and server
ConfigurationDescription: Removes the deprecated Server Message Block version 1 protocol, which has no support for signing or encryption.
ConfigurationRationale: SMBv1 has been superseded for more than a decade and is the transport abused by several self-propagating families.
RemediationOptions: Run Disable-WindowsOptionalFeature -Online -FeatureName SMB1Protocol on Windows client, or Remove-WindowsFeature FS-SMB1 on Windows Server.

ConfigurationName: Disable anonymous enumeration of shares
ConfigurationDescription: Determines whether anonymous logon users, that is null session connections, are allowed to list all account names and enumerate all shared resources.
ConfigurationRationale: Denying anonymous enumeration removes an unauthenticated discovery path into the estate.
RemediationOptions:
Option 1 - Set the following Group Policy:
Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Local Policies\Security Options\Network access: Do not allow anonymous enumeration of SAM accounts and shares to Enabled.

ConfigurationName: Disable the built-in guest account
ConfigurationDescription: Ensures the local guest account is disabled so it cannot be used to access the device without credentials.
ConfigurationRationale: The guest account provides unauthenticated access and is not required in a managed environment.
RemediationOptions: Set Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Local Policies\Security Options\Accounts: Guest account status to Disabled.

ConfigurationName: Enable PowerShell script block logging
ConfigurationDescription: Records the content of every script block PowerShell executes, including code that was decoded or generated at runtime.
ConfigurationRationale: Script block logging is frequently the only durable record of an obfuscated or in-memory payload.
RemediationOptions: Set Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\Windows PowerShell\Turn on PowerShell Script Block Logging to Enabled.

ConfigurationName: Enable the Windows Defender Firewall for the domain profile
ConfigurationDescription: Ensures host firewall filtering remains active while the device is connected to the corporate network.
ConfigurationRationale: Host firewalling contains lateral movement even when the network perimeter has been crossed.
RemediationOptions: Set Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Windows Defender Firewall\Domain Profile\Firewall state to On.

ConfigurationRationale: Unwanted applications frequently provide the remote access channel an intruder later reuses.
RemediationOptions: Run Set-MpPreference -PUAProtection Enabled.

ConfigurationRationale: Full volume encryption is the control that makes device loss a property incident rather than a data breach.

ConfigurationName: Onboard devices to Microsoft Defender for Endpoint
ConfigurationDescription: Ensures the endpoint reports sensor telemetry so detection, investigation, and response are possible on that device.
ConfigurationRationale: An unonboarded device is a blind spot; no detection or response capability applies to it.
RemediationOptions: Deploy the onboarding package from the Microsoft Defender portal, or assign the onboarding profile through Microsoft Intune.

ConfigurationName: Block credential stealing from the Windows local security authority subsystem
ConfigurationDescription: Attack Surface Reduction rules block the techniques most commonly used in malware and hands-on-keyboard intrusions. This rule prevents processes from opening a handle to lsass.exe to read credential material from memory.
ConfigurationRationale: Credential material harvested from LSASS enables lateral movement using valid accounts, which is difficult to detect once the attacker holds a legitimate ticket or hash.
RemediationOptions:
Option 1 - Set the following Group Policy:
Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\Microsoft Defender Antivirus\Microsoft Defender Exploit Guard\Attack Surface Reduction to Enabled and add rule GUID 9e6c4e1f-7d60-472f-ba1a-a39ef669e4b2 with value 1.
Option 2 - Run Set-MpPreference -AttackSurfaceReductionRules_Ids 9e6c4e1f-7d60-472f-ba1a-a39ef669e4b2 -AttackSurfaceReductionRules_Actions Enabled.

ConfigurationName: Block executable content from email client and webmail
ConfigurationDescription: Prevents executable files and scripts delivered as mail attachments from launching on the endpoint.
ConfigurationRationale: Mail remains the most common initial access vector, and blocking execution at the client stops the payload before it establishes a foothold.
RemediationOptions:
Option 1 - Set the Attack Surface Reduction rule GUID be9ba2d9-53ea-4cdc-84e5-9b1eeee46550 to Block.
Option 2 - Run Add-MpPreference -AttackSurfaceReductionRules_Ids be9ba2d9-53ea-4cdc-84e5-9b1eeee46550 -AttackSurfaceReductionRules_Actions Enabled.

ConfigurationName: Block Office communication application from creating child processes
ConfigurationDescription: Prevents Outlook from launching child processes, which stops payloads that rely on the mail client spawning a shell or script host.
ConfigurationRationale: Blocking child process creation removes an entire class of social engineering and exploit chains that pivot through the mail client.
RemediationOptions: Option 1 - Set the Attack Surface Reduction rule GUID 26190899-1602-49e8-8b27-eb1d0a1ce869 to Block.

ConfigurationName: Enable Local Security Authority protection
ConfigurationDescription: Runs the Local Security Authority as a protected process so that unsigned code cannot read or inject into it.
ConfigurationRationale: Protected process light prevents credential dumping tools from attaching to LSASS even when the operator holds administrator rights.
RemediationOptions: Set registry value HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa\RunAsPPL to 1 and restart the device.

ConfigurationName: Disable the SMBv1 client and server
ConfigurationDescription: Removes the deprecated Server Message Block version 1 protocol, which has no support for signing or encryption.
ConfigurationRationale: SMBv1 has been superseded for more than a decade and is the transport abused by several self-propagating families.
RemediationOptions: Run Disable-WindowsOptionalFeature -Online -FeatureName SMB1Protocol on Windows client, or Remove-WindowsFeature FS-SMB1 on Windows Server.

RemediationOptions:
Option 1 - Set the following Group Policy:
Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Local Policies\Security Options\Network access: Do not allow anonymous enumeration of SAM accounts and shares to Enabled.

ConfigurationName: Disable the built-in guest account
ConfigurationDescription: Ensures the local guest account is disabled so it cannot be used to access the device without credentials.
ConfigurationRationale: The guest account provides unauthenticated access and is not required in a managed environment.
RemediationOptions: Set Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Local Policies\Security Options\Accounts: Guest account status to Disabled.

ConfigurationName: Enable PowerShell script block logging

RemediationOptions: Set Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\Windows PowerShell\Turn on PowerShell Script Block Logging to Enabled.

ConfigurationRationale: Real-time protection is the control that stops commodity payloads before execution.
RemediationOptions: Run Set-MpPreference -DisableRealtimeMonitoring $false, and ensure tamper protection is enabled so the setting cannot be reverted.

ConfigurationName: Turn on potentially unwanted application protection in block mode
ConfigurationDescription: Blocks software that is not outright malicious but that degrades the security posture of the device, such as bundled toolbars and unauthorised remote access utilities.
ConfigurationRationale: Unwanted applications frequently provide the remote access channel an intruder later reuses.
RemediationOptions: Run Set-MpPreference -PUAProtection Enabled.

ConfigurationName: Enable BitLocker on the operating system drive
ConfigurationDescription: Encrypts the system volume so that data cannot be read by removing the disk or booting an alternative operating system.
ConfigurationRationale: Full volume encryption is the control that makes device loss a property incident rather than a data breach.
RemediationOptions: Enable BitLocker with a TPM protector and escrow the recovery key to Microsoft Entra ID before enforcing the policy.

ConfigurationName: Prohibit use of Internet Connection Sharing on your DNS domain network
ConfigurationDescription: Determines whether an existing internet connection, such as through wireless, can be shared and used by other systems, essentially creating a mobile hotspot.
ConfigurationRationale: Connection sharing creates an unmanaged bridge between the corporate network and an untrusted one.
RemediationOptions:
Option 1 - Set the following Group Policy:
Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Network\Network Connections\Prohibit use of Internet Connection Sharing on your DNS domain network to Enabled.

ConfigurationName: Onboard devices to Microsoft Defender for Endpoint
ConfigurationDescription: Ensures the endpoint reports sensor telemetry so detection, investigation, and response are possible on that device.
ConfigurationRationale: An unonboarded device is a blind spot; no detection or response capability applies to it.
RemediationOptions: Deploy the onboarding package from the Microsoft Defender portal, or assign the onboarding profile through Microsoft Intune.

ConfigurationName: Block credential stealing from the Windows local security authority subsystem
ConfigurationDescription: Attack Surface Reduction rules block the techniques most commonly used in malware and hands-on-keyboard intrusions. This rule prevents processes from opening a handle to lsass.exe to read credential material from memory.
ConfigurationRationale: Credential material harvested from LSASS enables lateral movement using valid accounts, which is difficult to detect once the attacker holds a legitimate ticket or hash.
RemediationOptions:
Option 1 - Set the following Group Policy:
Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\Microsoft Defender Antivirus\Microsoft Defender Exploit Guard\Attack Surface Reduction to Enabled and add rule GUID 9e6c4e1f-7d60-472f-ba1a-a39ef669e4b2 with value 1.
Option 2 - Run Set-MpPreference -AttackSurfaceReductionRules_Ids 9e6c4e1f-7d60-472f-ba1a-a39ef669e4b2 -AttackSurfaceReductionRules_Actions Enabled.

ConfigurationName: Block executable content from email client and webmail
ConfigurationDescription: Prevents executable files and scripts delivered as mail attachments from launching on the endpoint.
ConfigurationRationale: Mail remains the most common initial access vector, and blocking execution at the client stops the payload before it establishes a foothold.
RemediationOptions:
Option 1 - Set the Attack Surface Reduction rule GUID be9ba2d9-53ea-4cdc-84e5-9b1eeee46550 to Block.
Option 2 - Run Add-MpPreference -AttackSurfaceReductionRules_Ids be9ba2d9-53ea-4cdc-84e5-9b1eeee46550 -AttackSurfaceReductionRules_Actions Enabled.

ConfigurationName: Block Office communication application from creating child processes
ConfigurationDescription: Prevents Outlook from launching child processes, which stops payloads that rely on the mail client spawning a shell or script host.
ConfigurationRationale: Blocking child process creation removes an entire class of social engineering and exploit chains that pivot through the mail client.
RemediationOptions: Option 1 - Set the Attack Surface Reduction rule GUID 26190899-1602-49e8-8b27-eb1d0a1ce869 to Block.

ConfigurationName: Enable Local Security Authority protection
ConfigurationDescription: Runs the Local Security Authority as a protected process so that unsigned code cannot read or inject into it.
ConfigurationRationale: Protected process light prevents credential dumping tools from attaching to LSASS even when the operator holds administrator rights.
RemediationOptions: Set registry value HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa\RunAsPPL to 1 and restart the device.

ConfigurationName: Disable the SMBv1 client and server
ConfigurationDescription: Removes the deprecated Server Message Block version 1 protocol, which has no support for signing or encryption.
ConfigurationRationale: SMBv1 has been superseded for more than a decade and is the transport abused by several self-propagating families.
RemediationOptions: Run Disable-WindowsOptionalFeature -Online -FeatureName SMB1Protocol on Windows client, or Remove-WindowsFeature FS-SMB1 on Windows Server.

ConfigurationName: Disable anonymous enumeration of shares
ConfigurationDescription: Determines whether anonymous logon users, that is null session connections, are allowed to list all account names and enumerate all shared resources.
ConfigurationRationale: Denying anonymous enumeration removes an unauthenticated discovery path into the estate.
RemediationOptions:
Option 1 - Set the following Group Policy:
Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Local Policies\Security Options\Network access: Do not allow anonymous enumeration of SAM accounts and shares to Enabled.

ConfigurationName: Disable the built-in guest account
ConfigurationDescription: Ensures the local guest account is disabled so it cannot be used to access the device without credentials.
ConfigurationRationale: The guest account provides unauthenticated access and is not required in a managed environment.
RemediationOptions: Set Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Local Policies\Security Options\Accounts: Guest account status to Disabled.

ConfigurationName: Enable PowerShell script block logging
ConfigurationDescription: Records the content of every script block PowerShell executes, including code that was decoded or generated at runtime.
ConfigurationRationale: Script block logging is frequently the only durable record of an obfuscated or in-memory payload.
RemediationOptions: Set Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\Windows PowerShell\Turn on PowerShell Script Block Logging to Enabled.

ConfigurationName: Enable the Windows Defender Firewall for the domain profile
ConfigurationDescription: Ensures host firewall filtering remains active while the device is connected to the corporate network.
ConfigurationRationale: Host firewalling contains lateral movement even when the network perimeter has been crossed.
RemediationOptions: Set Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Windows Defender Firewall\Domain Profile\Firewall state to On.

ConfigurationName: Disable the built-in guest account
ConfigurationDescription: Ensures the local guest account is disabled so it cannot be used to access the device without credentials.

RemediationOptions: Set Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Local Policies\Security Options\Accounts: Guest account status to Disabled.

ConfigurationName: Enable PowerShell script block logging
ConfigurationDescription: Records the content of every script block PowerShell executes, including code that was decoded or generated at runtime.
ConfigurationRationale: Script block logging is frequently the only durable record of an obfuscated or in-memory payload.
RemediationOptions: Set Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\Windows PowerShell\Turn on PowerShell Script Block Logging to Enabled.

ConfigurationName: Enable the Windows Defender Firewall for the domain profile
ConfigurationDescription: Ensures host firewall filtering remains active while the device is connected to the corporate network.
ConfigurationRationale: Host firewalling contains lateral movement even when the network perimeter has been crossed.
RemediationOptions: Set Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Windows Defender Firewall\Domain Profile\Firewall state to On.

ConfigurationName: Enable Microsoft Defender Antivirus real-time protection
ConfigurationDescription: Keeps always-on scanning enabled so that malicious files are inspected as they are written and executed.
ConfigurationRationale: Real-time protection is the control that stops commodity payloads before execution.
RemediationOptions: Run Set-MpPreference -DisableRealtimeMonitoring $false, and ensure tamper protection is enabled so the setting cannot be reverted.

ConfigurationName: Turn on potentially unwanted application protection in block mode
ConfigurationDescription: Blocks software that is not outright malicious but that degrades the security posture of the device, such as bundled toolbars and unauthorised remote access utilities.
ConfigurationRationale: Unwanted applications frequently provide the remote access channel an intruder later reuses.
RemediationOptions: Run Set-MpPreference -PUAProtection Enabled.

ConfigurationName: Enable BitLocker on the operating system drive
ConfigurationDescription: Encrypts the system volume so that data cannot be read by removing the disk or booting an alternative operating system.
ConfigurationRationale: Full volume encryption is the control that makes device loss a property incident rather than a data breach.
RemediationOptions: Enable BitLocker with a TPM protector and escrow the recovery key to Microsoft Entra ID before enforcing the policy.

ConfigurationName: Prohibit use of Internet Connection Sharing on your DNS domain network
ConfigurationDescription: Determines whether an existing internet connection, such as through wireless, can be shared and used by other systems, essentially creating a mobile hotspot.

ConfigurationName: Onboard devices to Microsoft Defender for Endpoint
ConfigurationDescription: Ensures the endpoint reports sensor telemetry so detection, investigation, and response are possible on that device.

Option 2 - Run Set-MpPreference -AttackSurfaceReductionRules_Ids 9e6c4e1f-7d60-472f-ba1a-a39ef669e4b2 -AttackSurfaceReductionRules_Actions Enabled.

Option 1 - Set the Attack Surface Reduction rule GUID be9ba2d9-53ea-4cdc-84e5-9b1eeee46550 to Block.

ConfigurationRationale: Blocking child process creation removes an entire class of social engineering and exploit chains that pivot through the mail client.
RemediationOptions: Option 1 - Set the Attack Surface Reduction rule GUID 26190899-1602-49e8-8b27-eb1d0a1ce869 to Block.

ConfigurationName: Enable Local Security Authority protection
ConfigurationDescription: Runs the Local Security Authority as a protected process so that unsigned code cannot read or inject into it.
ConfigurationRationale: Protected process light prevents credential dumping tools from attaching to LSASS even when the operator holds administrator rights.
RemediationOptions: Set registry value HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa\RunAsPPL to 1 and restart the device.

ConfigurationName: Disable the SMBv1 client and server
ConfigurationDescription: Removes the deprecated Server Message Block version 1 protocol, which has no support for signing or encryption.
ConfigurationRationale: SMBv1 has been superseded for more than a decade and is the transport abused by several self-propagating families.
RemediationOptions: Run Disable-WindowsOptionalFeature -Online -FeatureName SMB1Protocol on Windows client, or Remove-WindowsFeature FS-SMB1 on Windows Server.

ConfigurationName: Disable anonymous enumeration of shares
ConfigurationDescription: Determines whether anonymous logon users, that is null session connections, are allowed to list all account names and enumerate all shared resources.
ConfigurationRationale: Denying anonymous enumeration removes an unauthenticated discovery path into the estate.
RemediationOptions:
Option 1 - Set the following Group Policy:
Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Local Policies\Security Options\Network access: Do not allow anonymous enumeration of SAM accounts and shares to Enabled.

ConfigurationName: Disable the built-in guest account
ConfigurationDescription: Ensures the local guest account is disabled so it cannot be used to access the device without credentials.
ConfigurationRationale: The guest account provides unauthenticated access and is not required in a managed environment.
RemediationOptions: Set Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Local Policies\Security Options\Accounts: Guest account status to Disabled.

ConfigurationName: Enable PowerShell script block logging
ConfigurationDescription: Records the content of every script block PowerShell executes, including code that was decoded or generated at runtime.
ConfigurationRationale: Script block logging is frequently the only durable record of an obfuscated or in-memory payload.
RemediationOptions: Set Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\Windows PowerShell\Turn on PowerShell Script Block Logging to Enabled.

ConfigurationName: Enable the Windows Defender Firewall for the domain profile
ConfigurationDescription: Ensures host firewall filtering remains active while the device is connected to the corporate network.
ConfigurationRationale: Host firewalling contains lateral movement even when the network perimeter has been crossed.
RemediationOptions: Set Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Windows Defender Firewall\Domain Profile\Firewall state to On.

ConfigurationName: Enable Microsoft Defender Antivirus real-time protection
ConfigurationDescription: Keeps always-on scanning enabled so that malicious files are inspected as they are written and executed.
ConfigurationRationale: Real-time protection is the control that stops commodity payloads before execution.
RemediationOptions: Run Set-MpPreference -DisableRealtimeMonitoring $false, and ensure tamper protection is enabled so the setting cannot be reverted.

ConfigurationName: Turn on potentially unwanted application protection in block mode
ConfigurationDescription: Blocks software that is not outright malicious but that degrades the security posture of the device, such as bundled toolbars and unauthorised remote access utilities.
ConfigurationRationale: Unwanted applications frequently provide the remote access channel an intruder later reuses.
RemediationOptions: Run Set-MpPreference -PUAProtection Enabled.

ConfigurationName: Enable BitLocker on the operating system drive
ConfigurationDescription: Encrypts the system volume so that data cannot be read by removing the disk or booting an alternative operating system.
ConfigurationRationale: Full volume encryption is the control that makes device loss a property incident rather than a data breach.
RemediationOptions: Enable BitLocker with a TPM protector and escrow the recovery key to Microsoft Entra ID before enforcing the policy.

ConfigurationName: Prohibit use of Internet Connection Sharing on your DNS domain network
ConfigurationDescription: Determines whether an existing internet connection, such as through wireless, can be shared and used by other systems, essentially creating a mobile hotspot.
ConfigurationRationale: Connection sharing creates an unmanaged bridge between the corporate network and an untrusted one.
RemediationOptions:
Option 1 - Set the following Group Policy:
Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Network\Network Connections\Prohibit use of Internet Connection Sharing on your DNS domain network to Enabled.

ConfigurationName: Onboard devices to Microsoft Defender for Endpoint
ConfigurationDescription: Ensures the endpoint reports sensor telemetry so detection, investigation, and response are possible on that device.
ConfigurationRationale: An unonboarded device is a blind spot; no detection or response capability applies to it.
RemediationOptions: Deploy the onboarding package from the Microsoft Defender portal, or assign the onboarding profile through Microsoft Intune.

ConfigurationName: Block credential stealing from the Windows local security authority subsystem
ConfigurationDescription: Attack Surface Reduction rules block the techniques most commonly used in malware and hands-on-keyboard intrusions. This rule prevents processes from opening a handle to lsass.exe to read credential material from memory.
ConfigurationRationale: Credential material harvested from LSASS enables lateral movement using valid accounts, which is difficult to detect once the attacker holds a legitimate ticket or hash.
RemediationOptions:
Option 1 - Set the following Group Policy:
Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\Microsoft Defender Antivirus\Microsoft Defender Exploit Guard\Attack Surface Reduction to Enabled and add rule GUID 9e6c4e1f-7d60-472f-ba1a-a39ef669e4b2 with value 1.
Option 2 - Run Set-MpPreference -AttackSurfaceReductionRules_Ids 9e6c4e1f-7d60-472f-ba1a-a39ef669e4b2 -AttackSurfaceReductionRules_Actions Enabled.

ConfigurationName: Block executable content from email client and webmail
ConfigurationDescription: Prevents executable files and scripts delivered as mail attachments from launching on the endpoint.
ConfigurationRationale: Mail remains the most common initial access vector, and blocking execution at the client stops the payload before it establishes a foothold.
RemediationOptions:
Option 1 - Set the Attack Surface Reduction rule GUID be9ba2d9-53ea-4cdc-84e5-9b1eeee46550 to Block.
Option 2 - Run Add-MpPreference -AttackSurfaceReductionRules_Ids be9ba2d9-53ea-4cdc-84e5-9b1eeee46550 -AttackSurfaceReductionRules_Actions Enabled.

RemediationOptions:
Option 1 - Set the following Group Policy:
Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\Microsoft Defender Antivirus\Microsoft Defender Exploit Guard\Attack Surface Reduction to Enabled and add rule GUID 9e6c4e1f-7d60-472f-ba1a-a39ef669e4b2 with value 1.
Option 2 - Run Set-MpPreference -AttackSurfaceReductionRules_Ids 9e6c4e1f-7d60-472f-ba1a-a39ef669e4b2 -AttackSurfaceReductionRules_Actions Enabled.

ConfigurationName: Block executable content from email client and webmail
ConfigurationDescription: Prevents executable files and scripts delivered as mail attachments from launching on the endpoint.
ConfigurationRationale: Mail remains the most common initial access vector, and blocking execution at the client stops the payload before it establishes a foothold.
RemediationOptions:
Option 1 - Set the Attack Surface Reduction rule GUID be9ba2d9-53ea-4cdc-84e5-9b1eeee46550 to Block.
Option 2 - Run Add-MpPreference -AttackSurfaceReductionRules_Ids be9ba2d9-53ea-4cdc-84e5-9b1eeee46550 -AttackSurfaceReductionRules_Actions Enabled.

ConfigurationName: Block Office communication application from creating child processes
ConfigurationDescription: Prevents Outlook from launching child processes, which stops payloads that rely on the mail client spawning a shell or script host.
ConfigurationRationale: Blocking child process creation removes an entire class of social engineering and exploit chains that pivot through the mail client.
RemediationOptions: Option 1 - Set the Attack Surface Reduction rule GUID 26190899-1602-49e8-8b27-eb1d0a1ce869 to Block.

ConfigurationName: Enable Local Security Authority protection
ConfigurationDescription: Runs the Local Security Authority as a protected process so that unsigned code cannot read or inject into it.
ConfigurationRationale: Protected process light prevents credential dumping tools from attaching to LSASS even when the operator holds administrator rights.
RemediationOptions: Set registry value HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa\RunAsPPL to 1 and restart the device.

ConfigurationName: Disable the SMBv1 client and server
ConfigurationDescription: Removes the deprecated Server Message Block version 1 protocol, which has no support for signing or encryption.
ConfigurationRationale: SMBv1 has been superseded for more than a decade and is the transport abused by several self-propagating families.
RemediationOptions: Run Disable-WindowsOptionalFeature -Online -FeatureName SMB1Protocol on Windows client, or Remove-WindowsFeature FS-SMB1 on Windows Server.

ConfigurationName: Disable anonymous enumeration of shares
ConfigurationDescription: Determines whether anonymous logon users, that is null session connections, are allowed to list all account names and enumerate all shared resources.
ConfigurationRationale: Denying anonymous enumeration removes an unauthenticated discovery path into the estate.
RemediationOptions:
Option 1 - Set the following Group Policy:
Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Local Policies\Security Options\Network access: Do not allow anonymous enumeration of SAM accounts and shares to Enabled.

ConfigurationName: Disable the built-in guest account
ConfigurationDescription: Ensures the local guest account is disabled so it cannot be used to access the device without credentials.
ConfigurationRationale: The guest account provides unauthenticated access and is not required in a managed environment.
RemediationOptions: Set Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Local Policies\Security Options\Accounts: Guest account status to Disabled.

ConfigurationName: Enable PowerShell script block logging
ConfigurationDescription: Records the content of every script block PowerShell executes, including code that was decoded or generated at runtime.
ConfigurationRationale: Script block logging is frequently the only durable record of an obfuscated or in-memory payload.
RemediationOptions: Set Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\Windows PowerShell\Turn on PowerShell Script Block Logging to Enabled.

ConfigurationName: Enable the Windows Defender Firewall for the domain profile
ConfigurationDescription: Ensures host firewall filtering remains active while the device is connected to the corporate network.
ConfigurationRationale: Host firewalling contains lateral movement even when the network perimeter has been crossed.
RemediationOptions: Set Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Windows Defender Firewall\Domain Profile\Firewall state to On.

ConfigurationName: Enable Microsoft Defender Antivirus real-time protection
ConfigurationDescription: Keeps always-on scanning enabled so that malicious files are inspected as they are written and executed.
ConfigurationRationale: Real-time protection is the control that stops commodity payloads before execution.
RemediationOptions: Run Set-MpPreference -DisableRealtimeMonitoring $false, and ensure tamper protection is enabled so the setting cannot be reverted.

ConfigurationName: Turn on potentially unwanted application protection in block mode
ConfigurationDescription: Blocks software that is not outright malicious but that degrades the security posture of the device, such as bundled toolbars and unauthorised remote access utilities.
ConfigurationRationale: Unwanted applications frequently provide the remote access channel an intruder later reuses.
RemediationOptions: Run Set-MpPreference -PUAProtection Enabled.

ConfigurationName: Enable BitLocker on the operating system drive
ConfigurationDescription: Encrypts the system volume so that data cannot be read by removing the disk or booting an alternative operating system.
ConfigurationRationale: Full volume encryption is the control that makes device loss a property incident rather than a data breach.
RemediationOptions: Enable BitLocker with a TPM protector and escrow the recovery key to Microsoft Entra ID before enforcing the policy.

ConfigurationName: Prohibit use of Internet Connection Sharing on your DNS domain network
ConfigurationDescription: Determines whether an existing internet connection, such as through wireless, can be shared and used by other systems, essentially creating a mobile hotspot.
ConfigurationRationale: Connection sharing creates an unmanaged bridge between the corporate network and an untrusted one.
RemediationOptions:
Option 1 - Set the following Group Policy:
Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Network\Network Connections\Prohibit use of Internet Connection Sharing on your DNS domain network to Enabled.

ConfigurationName: Onboard devices to Microsoft Defender for Endpoint
ConfigurationDescription: Ensures the endpoint reports sensor telemetry so detection, investigation, and response are possible on that device.
ConfigurationRationale: An unonboarded device is a blind spot; no detection or response capability applies to it.
RemediationOptions: Deploy the onboarding package from the Microsoft Defender portal, or assign the onboarding profile through Microsoft Intune.

ConfigurationDescription: Determines whether an existing internet connection, such as through wireless, can be shared and used by other systems, essentially creating a mobile hotspot.
